requirements.text: * 6+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years shipping production mobile apps on both iOS and Android.
* Proficiency in Swift or Kotlin with working knowledge of the other, and willingness to develop cross-platform fluency, as you will be responsible for both iOS and Android.
* You have owned mobile CI/CD pipelines and release infrastructure (e.g. Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions, Gradle, code signing, staged rollouts).
* You use AI coding tools daily to ship faster without lowering the quality bar, and have opinions on structuring a codebase and toolchain so agents work in it effectively.
* Experience with mobile auth: OAuth 2.0/PKCE, OIDC/SAML, MSAL, ASWebAuthenticationSession / Custom Tabs, Keychain and Android Keystore.
* Experience shipping OS integrations (widgets, App Intents / Shortcuts, extensions, background work) on at least one platform.
* Startup mindset: comfortable owning problems end to end, from infra to pixels, in an ambiguous environment.
* Nice to have: migrating a hybrid or cross-platform app to native; shipping in MDM/MAM-managed enterprise environments.
